item.description:
Sells gold stream to Sailfish for 70M shares (~49% stake)

Entered a non-binding LOI to sell a long-term gold stream to Sailfish Royalty Corp. Sailfish will issue 70M common shares (at $5.76/share, ~$403M) to Mako, giving Mako ~49% of Sailfish. The stream requires Mako to deliver 650-1,000 oz/month for 240 months at 25% of LBMA PM fix. Transaction aims to lower cost of capital and facilitate shareholder returns and accretive acquisitions; subject to definitive agreement and approvals.

About: Mako Mining Corp. engages in mineral exploration and exploitation activities in Nicaragua, the United States, and Guyana. The company explores for gold and silver deposits. Its primary asset is its 100%-owned San Albino mine comprising the San Albino and the Las Conchitas gold deposits, which consist of five mineral concessions covering an area of approximately 22,422 hectares located within the San Albino-Murra Property in Nueva Segovia, Nicaragua.
